summary: Extend actual canonical D3D9 menu/car/race pre-/post-Draw UpdateSurface/StretchRect and CPU/GDI color staging beyond the fixed eight-copy cap when byte-safe. Charge every successful full-backbuffer GetRenderTargetData against an explicit per-source-epoch 256 MiB budget with 64-op ceiling; preserve strict identity/format/Reset checks and original D3D9 input/FFB fallback.

feature_contract.goal: Keep a contiguous authentic game backbuffer pre-Draw seed and post-Draw native color during repeated menu/car/race CPU and StretchRect updates without dropping the native frame after eight successful copies at 1080p.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: 32 complete 1920x1080 canonical source snapshots can be charged in one menu/car source epoch without rejecting the ninth native game frame update.
Both pre-Draw snapshot and post-Draw native GPU copy account synchronized FULL source bytes, reject overflow or 64-plus snapshots and reset only on source epoch/Present/Reset.
Unverified source identity, format, failed readback, byte/copy budget overflow and device removal never publish native pixels; original D3D9 paths remain authoritative.
All five mandatory GitHub Actions pass at exact material source SHA without CI-skip.

acceptance_proof.positive_probe: C++ checks 32 genuine 1080p full readbacks in one color epoch, 3440x1440 resolution transitions, budget reset across Present/Reset and successful native-stage bookkeeping.
acceptance_proof.negative_regression: Reject bandwidth/copy-count exhaustion, integer overflow, invalid dimensions, unproven backbuffer and absent post-Draw target; original D3D9 fallback survives.
acceptance_proof.component_integration: D3D9 canonical backbuffer readback -> CPU/GDI/StretchRect pre-Draw snapshot or post-Draw D3D11 GPU copy -> full-source-readback budget charge only on success -> native Draw/Present

development_strategy.activation_guard_and_fallback: NativeDrawPathActive stays opt-in; original D3D9 rendering, input, FFB, DX9Ex fallback and DXVK frozen policy preserved.
development_strategy.blocking_evidence: At a752d261, preserve_game_surface_copy and begin_game_surface_cpu_write both hard-reject any ninth source copy via surfaceReplayCount>=8, despite full source captures being size dependent; the cap drops otherwise valid 1080p CPU/GDI and StretchRect frame history.

real_game_draw_blocker: Hard eight-copy ceiling rejects valid canonical game pre-/post-Draw backbuffer edits regardless of readback cost.
next_implementation_action: Confirm exact material SHA five mandatory GitHub Actions, repair only causal failures under 01053; require separate matching real-game/Quest3 evidence for runtime promotion.
